invite.label: Invitation code
invite.hint: Got a code from the organiser? Type it here — lowercase letters, spaces and dashes are fixed automatically.

errors.tier_too_low_other: The invitation needs at least {{count}} Flirt Passport stamps. Go to a few more events and try again.

verification.privacy: The selfie goes to the FLIRT server and is compared automatically with your profile photos. The server does not keep it and shows it to no one. If automatic verification is switched on, the image also reaches the external face verification provider, for the comparison only.
verification.cameraUnavailable: The camera can’t be started here. Take a selfie with your camera app or pick a recent photo — it works just as well.
verification.choose: Pick a photo or use your phone camera
verification.reviewNote: This exact photo goes for verification. Take another one if you are not happy with it.
verification.successBody: Done. The badge now shows on your profile.
verification.unavailableBody: Selfie verification is switched off for now. We will turn it back on once it works the way it should; until then nothing on your profile changes.

tips.light: Face a light source, do not stand with your back to a window.
tips.frame: Hold the phone at eye level and fit your whole face in the frame.
tips.sunglasses: Take off sunglasses, a mask, a hat or a hood.
